default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-878.title: Autocorrelation regime switch
E-878.hypothesis: When recent 1-bar returns are negatively autocorrelated, a large bar is noise from liquidity takers and reverts; when positively autocorrelated it is a continuing flow. Fade or follow by the measured sign.

E-879.title: Low-overlap bar sequence follow
E-879.hypothesis: Three bars barely overlapping means one side takes every price level without giving any back; follow it.

E-880.title: Volatility onset direction follow
E-880.hypothesis: When the short-window range jumps above its same-minute norm, informed flow has arrived; the net direction of the window continues for a while.

E-881.title: Two-bar spring
E-881.hypothesis: A sizable bar that sweeps the previous bar's extreme and closes beyond its midpoint traps stop-loss orders on the wrong side; trade the reversal.

E-882.title: Yesterday's range completion fade
E-882.hypothesis: Once today's range matches a fraction of yesterday's full range, new extremes that close back against their bar lose buyers/sellers; fade the poke.

E-883.title: Leg retracement resume
E-883.hypothesis: After a clear leg, a pullback to a fraction of it that turns back is where trend traders re-enter; follow the resumption.

E-884.title: Narrow-body cluster resolved by volume
E-884.hypothesis: A cluster of indecision bars followed by a full-body bar on higher volume shows resting orders have been consumed; follow the resolving bar.

E-885.title: Heavy-volume day trend-side EMA follow
E-885.hypothesis: On a day with cumulative volume above its norm, the side of the day open carries real participation; follow closes on that side of a short EMA.

E-886.title: Thin-book impact fade (Amihud)
E-886.hypothesis: A bar with a large range per contract traded moved a thin book, not real demand; liquidity providers take the other side and price reverts.

E-887.title: Volume-price correlation follow
E-887.hypothesis: When bar bodies and volume correlate strongly over a window, volume confirms direction (or its opposite for negative); follow a bar in that direction.
